  '@ IN NS ns.root.' \

### pc3.startup
ip address add 100.0.0.2/24 dev eth0
ip route add default via 100.0.0.1 dev eth0
ip address add 2001:8::2/64 dev eth0

# Recursive resolver: its only starting point is the internal root hint.
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y bind9
install -d /etc/bind
printf '%s\n' \
  'options {' \
  '    directory "/var/cache/bind";' \
  '    listen-on { any; };' \
  '    listen-on-v6 { any; };' \
  '    recursion yes;' \
  '    allow-query { any; };' \
  '    dnssec-validation no;' \
  '};' \
  'zone "." {' \
  '    type hint;' \
  '    file "/etc/bind/root.hints";' \
  '};' > /etc/bind/named.conf
printf '%s\n' \
  '. 3600000 IN NS ns.root.' \
  'ns.root. 3600000 IN A 100.0.6.2' > /etc/bind/root.hints
service bind9 restart

### pc5.startup

apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y bind9
install -d /etc/bind
printf '%s\n' \
  'options {' \
  '    directory "/var/cache/bind";' \
  '    listen-on { any; };' \
  '    listen-on-v6 { none; };' \
  '    recursion no;' \
  '};' \
  'zone "test." {' \
  '    type master;' \
  '    file "/etc/bind/db.test";' \
  '};' > /etc/bind/named.conf
printf '%s\n' \
  '$TTL 86400' \
  '@ IN SOA ns.test. hostmaster.test. ( 1 3600 900 604800 86400 )' \
  '@ IN NS ns.test.' \
  'ns.test. IN A 100.0.8.2' \
  'www.test. IN A 200.0.1.2' > /etc/bind/db.test
service bind9 restart

Configurato il lab senza modificare router, indirizzi o routing statico.

- `pc2`: DNS autoritativo per `.` con delega `test.` a `ns.test.` e glue `100.0.8.2`.
- `pc5`: unico autoritativo per `test.`, con `www.test. A 200.0.1.2`.
- `pc3`: resolver ricorsivo con root hint interna `100.0.6.2`, senza forwarder e con `dnssec-validation no;`, in ascolto IPv4/IPv6.
- `pc4` usa `100.0.0.2`; `pc6` usa `2001:8::2`.
- `pc1` avvia Apache HTTP.

La sintassi di `lab.conf` è stata validata da Kathara. Il test in esecuzione non è possibile qui perché il daemon Docker non è accessibile.
